exposure: seizure control one year prior to pregnancy
cohort: One hundred twelve pregnant women with epilepsy (WWE) with planned versus unplanned pregnancies.
finding: Seizure control prior to pregnancy, epilepsy type, adherence to ASM therapy, and pregnancy planning are potential factors influencing both seizure control and delivery outcomes in women with epilepsy.
mod_finding: Women with seizures during pregnancy and with non-adherence to ASM treatment had a higher rate of cesarean section.
followup_time: at least three years after delivery
